text:
I went on undressing you of yourself...

I went on

        undressing you of yourself,

of the superimposed "yous" that life

had

        fitted around you...

I tore away the

        bark-whole and hard-

that believed itself fruit, that had

the shape of

        fruit.

And before the

        vague astonishment of your eyes

you emerged with your eyes still veiled

in

        darkness and astonishments...

You emerged from

        yourself; from your own

fertile shadow, intact and torn

into living

        soul...

translation.title: I Went On Undressing You of Yourself...
translation.editorial_note: The source catalog title says 'Hidden Water,' but the visible body is a broken-spaced variant of 'Yo te fui desnudando...'.
